content.text: This text is an extensive medical index covering diseases, symptoms, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, and treatments, primarily involving the gastrointestinal system, liver, pancreas, biliary tract, rectum, and related organs. Major topics include gastralgia, acute and chronic gastritis, intestinal catarrh, indigestion, obstruction, ulcers, worms, jaundice, gallstones, hepatic diseases, pancreatic disorders, peritonitis, rheumatism, scrofula, scurvy, syphilis, pharyngitis, oesophageal disease, stomach cancer, and rectal disorders. Entries cross-reference clinical signs, anatomical findings, causes, complications, historical theories, and numerous 19th-century therapies, including dietary measures, medicines, enemas, irrigation, baths, opium, mercury, quinine, surgery, puncture, and laparotomy.
